name: faultline
description: KOZMOS Faultline: the error lens in a sidebar. Every failed or denied tool call, refused or errored turn and API error, grouped by a masked signature with count, first and last seen, the agents that hit it, the full first error (expandable) and a copy button, under a severity strip of the last 10 minutes. /faultline toggles it.

autoOpen.title: Open on start
autoOpen.description: Open the Faultline sidebar when a session starts (where the layout docks panes).
